repos.name: vggt
repos.command: .venv/bin/python -c "import torch; torch.set_grad_enabled(False); from vggt.models.aggregator import Aggregator; from vggt.utils.rotation import quat_to_mat, mat_to_quat; m = Aggregator(img_size=112, patch_size=14, embed_dim=128, depth=2, num_heads=4, patch_embed='conv', cached_layer_indices=(1,)).eval(); out, i = m(torch.rand(1, 2, 3, 112, 112)); q = torch.nn.functional.normalize(torch.randn(256, 4), dim=-1); R = quat_to_mat(q); print(torch.__version__, out[-1].shape, i, float((quat_to_mat(mat_to_quat(R)) - R).abs().max()))"
